interpolation: linear; do not overshoot; endpoint hold through audio tail

coordinateConvention.image: Source image as displayed; no horizontal mirroring applied.
coordinateConvention.leftRight: L/R are target character anatomical sides in a front view: L=screen-right, R=screen-left. Source selfie mirroring is unknown; reproduce displayed gesture side rather than asserting performer anatomy.

confidence.frameTimestamps: Exact ffprobe best_effort_timestamp_time for each reviewed source frame; nominalSampleTime is the rounded 0.1 s label used for visual annotation.
confidence.mouthEyeStates: Manual visual classification at 10 Hz, approximately +/-0.1 s event timing; closed vs narrow lids can be uncertain under makeup/motion blur.
confidence.weights: Heuristic editing suggestions, not calibrated blendshape measurements.
confidence.headGaze: Lower-confidence signed direction suggestions and interpolated amplitudes, not 3D pose estimates. Convergence especially uncertain.
confidence.phonemes: Unverified. Round/open/closed visual states are not spoken phoneme labels.

composition.basis: Semantic closed rest. A currently open-A modeled asset MUST be calibrated first; do not feed seal and opening without testing their composition.
composition.mouthSeal: Explicit keyed envelope. Closed visual states =>1; aperture=>0. Do not automatically force mouthSeal=1 across smile/pucker/open states.
composition.eyeActing: Suspend random/idle blink during reference playback; manual closures and squints own eyelids.
composition.gaze: Suspend random idle gaze; head and eye curves are distinct.
composition.validation: Keyframes are simultaneous pose recipes. Test at each key and .25/.5/.75 between keys on actual geometry.
composition.unsupported: Report and omit unavailable keys; do not pretend tongue, hands, or nose wrinkle are reproduced.

controlRanges.name: headYaw
controlRanges.description: Positive nose turn toward screen right. Suggested maximum mapping +20 degrees, not measured.

controlRanges.description: Positive chin up. Suggested maximum mapping +15 degrees, not measured.

controlRanges.name: headRoll
controlRanges.description: Positive clockwise rotation of head in image. Suggested maximum mapping +20 degrees, not measured.

controlRanges.name: gazeX
controlRanges.description: Positive screen right (character left in a front view). Gaze-only offset; do not add head rotation twice.

controlRanges.name: gazeY
controlRanges.description: Positive screen up.

controlRanges.name: gazeConverge
controlRanges.description: Apparent convergence around 1.1--1.3 s and 9.6 s. Low confidence; independent L/R aim needed. Do not force conjugate gaze to mimic it.

controlRanges.name: lean
controlRanges.description: Positive toward camera; subject movement, not camera zoom. Low confidence normalized translation suggestion.

controlRanges.name: headShiftX
controlRanges.description: Positive sideways toward screen right. Separate from roll/yaw; low-confidence normalized translation suggestion. Late grinning sways mainly shift sideways.

controlRanges.name: tongueOut
controlRanges.description: Observed tongue protrusion. Explicit unsupported track until a tested tongue control exists.

controlRanges.name: tongueSide
controlRanges.description: Positive visible tongue toward screen right. Separate from mouth corner shift.

controlRanges.name: noseWrinkle
controlRanges.description: Visible nose scrunch with upper-lip curl at 6.7--6.9 s; separate unsupported requirement if no shape exists.
